== Notes ==
* As this is the only skill measured in feet, it can be hard to judge the wire’s range. 75' or [[range#Gwinches|900"]] is just slightly shorter than [[earshot range]], [[shortbow]] and [[spear]] range, or the size of your [[danger zone|aggro bubble]].

== Trivia ==
* This spell is similar to one of [[w:Scorpion (Mortal_Kombat)|Scorpion]]'s moves from the console fighting game [[w:Mortal Kombat (video game)|Mortal Kombat]].
* During an [[Game updates/20090401|April Fools' Day update]], this skill was further related to Scorpion from Mortal Kombat by mocking a change to its functionality to match that of the Mortal Kombat variant.
